Australian fitness enthusiasts are increasingly choosing running clubs in parks over traditional pub socializing, indicating a broader trend toward outdoor fitness and community-based exercise. This shift represents a growing preference for social fitness activities that could impact how gyms need to structure their offerings and community engagement strategies.
